column1: #   name          - Unique service identifier (case-insensitive CLI target)
#   emoji         - Optional display icon (leave empty or '-' for none)
#   path          - Relative path inside WORKSPACE_DIR (e.g. backend-repo or monorepo/api)
#   port          - Default listening TCP port (empty or '-' for portless workers; overridden by .env PORT)
#   cmd_unix      - Script filename in service dir (e.g. run-local.sh) OR inline shell command
#   cmd_win       - Script filename in service dir (e.g. run-local.bat / .ps1) OR inline command
#                   and is loaded into the service's isolated environment before startup; missing .env fails start.
#   stop_pattern  - Optional ';'-separated pgrep/cmdline patterns for force-stop orphan cleanup
#   hints         - Optional banner hint shown in interactive terminal windows

column9: [r] Hot reload  [R] Hot restart  [h] Help  [d] DevTools  [q] Quit
